messages.author: Lucas Ferreira
messages.text: PSA: the display font we use for the 'ROLL!' headline is licensed for print and app, *not* for paid video. Legal flagged it. I've switched all new exports to the house font from the brand kit.

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: Thanks for catching it. Existing live ads are fine until the next rotation, per Legal.
